title: Conserved mRNP remodeling mechanism of the TREX-2.1 complex.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Pulled the open-access full text (PMC13569498) and read its data availability statement and methods. Queried the RCSB Protein Data Bank entry 9ZEB: released 2026-09-30, cryo-electron microscopy, 3.72 Angstrom resolution, 4 protein chains, 7,777 atoms, 1,309 residues. Queried the Electron Microscopy Data Bank entry EMD-74098: status RELEASED. Read every supplementary-table mention in the methods to see what each table contains.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The contents of Supplementary Tables S1-S7 (reagents, plasmids, oligonucleotides, yeast strains, two crosslink summaries, cryo-EM collection statistics) are from the methods text; the Europe PMC supplementary-file endpoint timed out and I did not retry it. The PRIDE proteomics entry PXD073414 returned 404 from the PRIDE application programming interface, so I could not open those files; its scope (photo-crosslinking of three single-residue Sub2 variants, analysed with pLink3) comes from the methods.

a1_downloadable.note: Protein Data Bank entry 9ZEB and Electron Microscopy Data Bank map EMD-74098 are both released and freely downloadable; I confirmed both by application programming interface. PRIDE entry PXD073414 returned 404, possibly still embargoed.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: There is no prediction target anywhere. The outputs are one atomic model, one density map, and a handful of crosslinked residue pairs; any label (contact, regulatory effect, splicing change) would have to be constructed from scratch.

a3_inputs_present.note: Protein sequences for Thp3, Csn12, Sem1 and Sub2 are in the Protein Data Bank entry; not assessed further since A2 already failed.

a4_units_stated.note: Structural quantities carry standard units (Angstrom resolution, B-factors); reverse-transcription quantitative PCR results are relative fold-changes by the delta-delta-Ct method. Moot given A2.

a5_enough_rows.note: One structure (1,309 modelled residues), one map, three photo-crosslinking samples, and reverse-transcription quantitative PCR on a few intron-containing genes. Far under the ~1,500-row bar; the unit of observation is a single complex.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: <1 GB (one coordinate file plus one cryo-EM map)
a6_fits_laptop.note: Trivially small; verified file-level metadata through the Protein Data Bank and Electron Microscopy Data Bank.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Paper's stated 3.72 Angstrom resolution matches the Protein Data Bank record exactly; nothing else has a count to compare.

a8_label_provenance.note: No label exists to trace, so circularity cannot be assessed. Note the deposited model was built by docking prior crystal structures (Protein Data Bank 7EWM, 5SUP) into the map, so coordinates are partly model-derived.

honest_claim_h3: No machine-learning claim is supportable: the paper's deposited data is one 3.72 Angstrom cryo-electron microscopy structure of a four-protein complex plus three crosslinking samples, which is one observation, not a dataset.

plain_idea.one_liner: Considered and rejected: use protein sequence to predict which residues of an RNA-unwinding enzyme contact its regulatory partner complex.
plain_idea.train_on: Would have trained on residue pairs from the single deposited structure (Protein Data Bank 9ZEB, 1,309 modelled residues across 4 chains) plus two tables of photo-crosslinks from three Sub2 variants. That is one complex, not a training set.
plain_idea.predict: Would have predicted interface residues or the regulatory effect of mutating them; the true answers come from this one cryo-electron microscopy map and from gel-based ATPase and crosslinking assays on a few single-residue variants.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: The biology matters to the messenger-RNA export field, but a single structure teaches a model nothing; at best it is one test case for an existing complex-structure predictor, not a project.

ml_idea: None viable. The only machine-learning use of this paper is as a single held-out test case for a protein-complex structure predictor (for example asking whether an AlphaFold-style predictor reproduces the Thp3-Csn12-Sem1-Sub2 arrangement and the 'trigger loop' contact), which is a one-afternoon sanity check, not a project with training data.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from the Protein Data Bank record (7,777 atoms) and typical cryo-electron microscopy map sizes; nothing was timed because there is nothing to train on.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the deposited rows: one Protein Data Bank entry, one map, two crosslink tables. Done in two application programming interface calls, and it kills the project.

verdict_reason: Mechanistic cryo-electron microscopy paper with one structure and no tabular measurements; fails A5 (n=1) and A2 (no label column).
